<compartment start="79" end="94" title="Auditable proration credit ledger" episode_type="design,feature,release" importance="86">
<p1>
U: "credits are money; don't hide them in metadata"

Built Billetto's proration credit flow around real ledger entries instead of Stripe invoice metadata. The new billing/src/credits/proration.ts calculates unused-time and downgrade credits against subscription_version, then writes account_credit_entries tied to invoice_line_id. U: "we need ledger lines you can audit in six months"

Retries reuse the same idempotency key and detect existing ledger entries instead of minting another credit. Added migration 202605101422_add_account_credit_entries.sql, rollback dry-run fixtures, and a release check that compares Stripe invoice totals against the local ledger. Commit 6c2d8ef.
</p1>
<p2>
Billetto proration credits are ledger entries because U: "credits are money; don't hide them in metadata". account_credit_entries ties credits to invoice_line_id and subscription_version for auditable retries.
</p2>
<p3>
Billetto made proration credits auditable by storing them in its own ledger table rather than Stripe metadata.
</p3>
<p4>account_credit_entries; subscription_version; proration idempotency key</p4>
</compartment>
<facts>
<PROJECT_RULES>
* Billetto billing migrations must include a rollback dry-run against test/fixtures/billing-ledger/.
</PROJECT_RULES>
<ARCHITECTURE>
* Billetto represents credits as account_credit_entries tied to invoice_line_id, not as Stripe metadata.
* Billetto proration calculation is idempotent around subscription_version and reuses existing ledger entries on retry.
</ARCHITECTURE>
<CONSTRAINTS>
* Stripe invoice metadata is not a durable Billetto credit ledger because dashboard edits can mutate it outside the app.
</CONSTRAINTS>
<CONFIG_VALUES>
* Billetto credit_kind enum values are unused_time, plan_downgrade, and manual_adjustment.
* Billetto Stripe idempotency key format for proration is proration:{account_id}:{subscription_version}:{invoice_id}.
</CONFIG_VALUES>
<NAMING>
* The Billetto credit ledger table is named account_credit_entries; "negative_invoice_lines" was rejected.
</NAMING>
</facts>

<compartment start="15" end="22" title="Stopped contrastive loss cliff" episode_type="investigation,bug" importance="82">
<p1>
U: "can you chase the loss cliff, not tune around it"

Investigated Nereid's contrastive trainer after loss jumped from 0.42 to 3.8 around step 17.8k on A100 runs. The tempting path was LR tuning, but crop-hash logging showed duplicated augmentations across dataloader workers after worker_init_fn was dropped in 6fb2d90. Restored per-worker seeding in training/data/seed.py, added epoch_seed to the run manifest, and reran runs/2026-05-08/a100-bf16-rerun through 52k steps without the cliff. Commit c8e4a11.
</p1>
<p2>
Nereid's loss cliff was caused by shared augmentation seeds across dataloader workers, not optimizer settings. training/data/seed.py now derives worker seeds from base seed, worker id, and epoch.
</p2>
<p3>
Nereid contrastive training stabilized after restoring per-worker augmentation seeds.
</p3>
<p4>worker_init_fn; augmentation_seed; runs/2026-05-08/a100-bf16-rerun</p4>
</compartment>
<facts>
<CONSTRAINTS>
* Nereid's contrastive trainer can diverge if augmentation_seed is shared across dataloader workers.
</CONSTRAINTS>
<CONFIG_VALUES>
* Nereid worker augmentation seed formula is base_seed + worker_id + epoch * 1009.
</CONFIG_VALUES>
</facts>
<events>
<causal_incident at_compartment="2">
  <summary>Training loss cliff traced to duplicated augmentation seeds.</summary>
  <affected_surface>other</affected_surface>
  <symptom>Contrastive loss jumped from 0.42 to 3.8 around step 17.8k on A100 runs.</symptom>
  <cause_summary>worker_init_fn had been removed, causing dataloader workers to reuse augmentation seeds.</cause_summary>
  <disposition>fixed</disposition>
  <evidence>Crop-hash logging showed duplicated augmentations across dataloader workers.</evidence>
  <fix_summary>Restored per-worker seed derivation in training/data/seed.py and recorded epoch_seed in run manifests.</fix_summary>
</causal_incident>
</events>

<compartment start="65" end="69" title="Kept ranked parties intact" episode_type="feature" importance="54">
<p1>
U: "keep duos together even if it adds 30s; don't split the party for math"

Updated Arcade Relay matchmaking in services/matchmaker/src/ranked_duo.rs so party_id is a hard constraint. The ranked_duo queue now widens MMR windows over time before considering cross-region fallback, and the solver rejects any candidate lobby that splits a party. Added simulations in services/matchmaker/test/fixtures/duo_wait_curves.json. Commit 5b1e7aa.
</p1>
<p2>
Arcade Relay ranked_duo matchmaking treats party_id as non-splittable and widens MMR windows before relaxing anything else.
</p2>
<p3>
Ranked duo matchmaking now preserves parties even when it increases queue time.
</p3>
<p4>ranked_duo; party_id hard constraint; duo_wait_curves</p4>
</compartment>
<facts>
<PROJECT_RULES>
* Arcade Relay matchmaker must not split a party_id across ranked lobbies; widen match criteria before breaking party constraints.
</PROJECT_RULES>
<CONFIG_VALUES>
* Arcade Relay ranked_duo MMR window widens by 75 every 15s up to 450.
</CONFIG_VALUES>
</facts>

<compartment start="160" end="168" title="Manual page rotation escape hatch" episode_type="feature,bug" importance="27">
<p1>
Started by trying to auto-rotate ugly multi-scan uploads in the docket OCR intake, then backed away from making low-confidence guesses.
U: if confidence is fuzzy, give support a knob instead of guessing.

ingest/api/src/routes/upload.ts now stores an optional per-page rotation override alongside the upload manifest, and web/src/components/PageRotationOverride.tsx gives support a manual control in triage. Automatic rotation only applies when the OCR angle model is confidently right; the rest stay untouched until a human steps in. docs/support/scan-triage.md covers when to use the override. Commit 7ab2c54.
</p1>
<p2>
The rotation fix became a support-side escape hatch, not aggressive automation.
U: if confidence is fuzzy, give support a knob instead of guessing.

ingest/api/src/routes/upload.ts persists per-page overrides, web/src/components/PageRotationOverride.tsx exposes them in triage, and auto-rotation stays gated behind a high confidence threshold.
</p2>
<p3>
Low-confidence scan rotation is now handled through a manual override path, with automation reserved for only the most certain OCR angle predictions.
</p3>
<p4>PageRotationOverride; upload manifest override; angle_confidence threshold</p4>
</compartment>
<facts>
<CONSTRAINTS>
* OCR angle predictions below a high confidence threshold are not reliable enough for unattended page rotation on messy multi-scan uploads.
</CONSTRAINTS>
<CONFIG_VALUES>
* Automatic rotation threshold: angle_confidence 0.98 or higher.
</CONFIG_VALUES>
</facts>
<events>
<trajectory_correction at_compartment="19">
  <summary>Changed scan rotation from auto-fix ambition to manual override with high-confidence automation only.</summary>
  <before_strategy>Use OCR angle predictions to auto-rotate problematic scans broadly during ingest.</before_strategy>
  <correction_source>user</correction_source>
  <correction_signal>U: if confidence is fuzzy, give support a knob instead of guessing.</correction_signal>
  <after_strategy>Persist per-page rotation overrides and reserve automatic rotation for only high-confidence predictions.</after_strategy>
  <evidence>The final implementation added PageRotationOverride in triage UI and left ingest auto-rotation behind a strict confidence gate.</evidence>
</trajectory_correction>
</events>
<user_observations>
* User accepts deterministic manual escape hatches faster than vague low-confidence automation when support burden is obvious.
</user_observations>

<p1>

候选提交后实际 Oracle 有界审最终 SHA，回报真实代码/测试/报告，总协调合 dev、E 独立验收。

[453-455] 取证：内存 10.5GB 可用、swap 0；`mvp-b-pg` 为 Exited(0)（授权可恢复，禁清库/卷）；无端口占用；基线 `f04543345ad8a6e649b19c0e9708120700f1897d`（allenxun "Merge reviewed Swagger integration into dev"）本地存在但**非 HEAD 祖先**，带入 18 提交/130 文件/+16594−353（E 的独立验收资产 + 4 份 E 交付文档）。合并预演 `git merge-tree --write-tree` 退出 0、冲突 0，且基线完全不触及三个目标写域。合并成功：**merge commit `39adc57c290e6cef4af336935ee7112f34bdca0b`**，parents 恰为 `551f166`+`f045433`，树 clean、零冲突标记；`mvp-b-pg` 恢复 Up，`mvp_b_dev`/两个 accept 库/`swagger_preview` 全部完好未清空。

[456-459] 定位 CC-11 权威机器可读来源：`backend/acceptance/driver/c_care.py:102` 的 `CC11_CONTRACT_ALLOWLIST`（13 条真四元组：API+归一化实例路径+validator+`absolute_schema_path`）与 `E-C-acceptance.md:55` 的 13 个字段路径。确认三项代码落点：`runtime/loop.py`（`run_cycle():185`、`run_forever():216-228`）、`scanners/incident_scanner.py:142 run_once`、`handlers/media_cleanup.py`（已在 `handlers/__init__.py:133` 注册）、`AuthController.invalidateDestinations:190-203`（现为单条 UPDATE 但未递增 revision 且被 try/catch 吞异常）。13 处根因集中在 `Progress.completedAt`、`ControllerRef.gimbalId`、`Verification.validUntil`、`CareExecutionListItem.closedAt`（12 处 nullable 与 $ref/allOf 同层）+ `ProgressWithSync` 经 allOf 被 `Progress.additionalProperties:false` 误伤。派发 fix-2（Python 调度）、fix-3（契约）、fix-4（Java 登出），写域互斥、构建工具各自独占。

[460] 首派项 2 的 Java 道（fix-1，`ses_f6f97435affeHYpSwQpFW9ngti`）以 `unknown certificate verification error` 失败（传输层/证书基础设施故障，非代码或任务书问题）。

[461-465] 我对账：失败道**零产出**——HEAD 仍 `39adc57`、`git status` 空、`AuthController` 中 `destination_revision` 出现 0 次、无新增登出测试、`.coordination/B-work/integration-fix/` 为空。因 fix-1 无上下文可保留，**新开一条道**重派为 fix-4（不复用证书故障会话）。注意当前唯一 pytest 进程来自 `.worktrees/mvp-e`（E 自己的会话跑 `test_sc02.py`），不属我方。落盘 `.coordination/B-work/ledger-round5.md` 按裁定准确列出待协调项（C25 APP 须跨登录/refresh/重启持久化 observationEpoch+单调 observationSeq 或改用 ConnectionProofVerifier 可信 generation；C26 容量初值 32~64、`session-table-full-fail-closed` 告警、凭据轮换/受控重置 runbook、"仅调高上限不是恢复机制"；`session_id` 名实不符且中间版本不得原地升级；Swagger 两条 SUGGESTION 处置；E 需自行更新 CC-11 期望；C22/C23/C-D 跨包验收）。
</p1>
<p2>
获用户/总协调扩展授权：我为本轮公共集成修复唯一实施负责人，复用 mvp-b，不恢复 A/C/D；只把基线合入本 feature、不反向合入、不推送；网络不放 PG 锁内、不加服务/新队列、不每轮无界扫描；不改验收驱动放宽校验；可恢复 mvp-b-pg 但禁止清库/卷；不自行推送/归档/合入 dev。合并预演冲突 0 后合入基线 `f045433` → merge commit `39adc57`（parents 551f166+f045433，mvp-b-pg 恢复 Up、库卷完好）。从 `c_care.py:102 CC11_CONTRACT_ALLOWLIST` 提取 13 条四元组，确认三项代码落点，派发 fix-2/3/4（写域互斥）。首派 Java 道 fix-1 因 `unknown certificate verification error` 零产出失败，对账后新开 fix-4 重派；落盘 ledger-round5.md 列清 C25/C26 等待协调项。

<p3>

<compartment start="466" end="478" title="三项公共集成修复实施完成、独立复核与按项提交" episode_type="bug,feature,investigation" importance="68">
<p1>
本轮三项公共集成修复的三条道全部终结，我逐条独立复核后按项提交，不采信子任务自报。

[466] fix-3（契约道）完成 CC-11 的 13 处 OpenAPI 建模修复，唯一改动 `backend/contracts/openapi/openapi.yaml`（34 行）：12 处 `nullable` 由"与 `allOf/$ref` 同层（不生效）"改为与 `type` 同对象（`Verification.validUntil`、`Progress.completedAt`、`ControllerRef.gimbalId`、`CareExecutionListItem.closedAt` 四个叶子字段），`ProgressWithSync` 由 `allOf:[Progress,{lastSyncedAt}]` 展平为显式 7 属性并保留 `required` 与 `additionalProperties:false`（严格性未降）；业务字段集合/required/format/enum/状态码/x-error-codes/operationId/x-api-id 均未变。四项契约校验修复前后数字一致（openapi VALID、responses selftest 10-0、samples 50-0、jcs 26 checks）；自建 `cc11_directed_strict_check.py` 具双向判别力（修复前 14/14 复现缺陷、修复后 14/14 全过）。

[468] fix-4（Java 登出道）把 `AuthController.invalidateDestinations` 改为**单条原子 UPDATE**：同一 SET 内 `status='invalid'`+`invalidated_at=now()`+`updated_at=now()`+`destination_revision = destination_revision + 1`，`WHERE session_ref=? AND status='active'` 保幂等、无 TOCTOU；HTTP 仍 204 无体，warn 日志去除 `session_ref` 明文；新增 `LogoutDestinationRevisionIT` 4 项。它如实标注一致性边界：控制器无 `@Transactional`、走 autocommit，故 T09 侧"失效+递增"原子，但会话撤销在 `SessionProvider`（内存 double，14 表无 session 表）内、**不在 DB 事务中** ⇒ 不能声称"与撤销同一事务"。

[469-470] 复核 fix-3 时我发现**我自己的两处校验缺陷**并纠正：awk 锚点未匹配致 pre/post 文件皆空、`diff` 报 "IDENTICAL" 是**假阳性**；`jcs.py --selftest` 实为位置参数 `selftest`，首次只打印 usage 却被我当作通过。用正确参数重跑 = PASS 26 checks rc=0。第 2615/2654 行残留旧式 `allOf+nullable` 属 `ExecutionClosureResult`/`CareExecutionView`（off-path 32 处之一），**不是** `CareExecutionListItem`。

[471] fix-2（Python 调度道）在既有 Worker 进程内接入两个有界周期任务：新增 `scanners/scheduler.py`（`PeriodicTask` 非阻塞 `threading.Lock` 重入守卫 / `PeriodicScheduler.run_due()` / `next_wait_seconds=min(最近到期,max_wait)` / `build_worker_scanner`），挂载 `runtime/loop.py` 的 `run_forever()`（`:242 run_due()`、`:247-248 stop_event.wait(next_wait_seconds(poll))`）；`incident_scanner.run_once` 新增 `ScanCursors`，三段候选 SQL 加 UUID keyset `id > :after_id ORDER BY id LIMIT`；4 个新旋钮；**未新增进程/线程/队列/cron**，`claim|complete|renew|expire|rows.py`、`handlers/__init__.py`、D 的 `media_cleanup.py` 均未改。

[472-478] 我亲验三道全部通过：项 3 属性集精确比对 `Progress`/`ControllerRef`/`Verification`/`CareExecutionListItem` PRE=POST IDENTICAL、`ProgressWithSync` 展平为 7 字段、`backend/acceptance/**` 零改动；项 1 `claim|complete|renew|expire|rows.py` 与 `handlers/**` diff 为空、C7 红线保持（扫描器只读 `last_seen_at`）、pytest 230 passed rc=0；项 2 mvn 401/0/0 rc=0。按项分离提交 `2bd768a`（契约）/`d0e9b84`（登出）/`2d6c723`（调度），最终代码 SHA = `2d6c7231f2d2aa58ec0501e8550a0f35b8bd2533`，合计 10 文件、0 工件、0 个 E 资产文件、工作树 clean。在 `2d6c723` 复跑端到端 `run-acceptance-b.sh` = **ALL PASS 39/39 SCRIPT_RC=0**，送 ora-1 有界复审。
</p1>
<p2>
本轮三项公共集成修复三条道全部终结，我逐条独立复核后按项提交。项 3 契约：`openapi.yaml` 12 处 `nullable` 改为与 `type` 同对象 + `ProgressWithSync` 由 allOf 展平为显式 7 属性（保留 required 与 additionalProperties:false）；四项校验全绿、定向脚本双向判别成立。项 2 Java：`AuthController.invalidateDestinations` 单条原子 UPDATE 内 `status='invalid'`+`destination_revision+1`（WHERE status='active' 保幂等），204 不变；新增 `LogoutDestinationRevisionIT` 4 项。项 1 Python：新增 `scanners/scheduler.py` 挂载 `runtime/loop.py`、`incident_scanner` 三段 keyset+ORDER BY id LIMIT；未改租约/失败事务守卫。我亲验：属性集 PRE=POST IDENTICAL、`claim|complete|renew|expire|rows.py` 与 `handlers/**` diff 为空、C7 保持、pytest 230 passed、mvn 401/0/0。按项提交 `2bd768a`/`d0e9b84`/`2d6c723`，最终代码 SHA `2d6c7231f2d2aa58ec0501e8550a0f35b8bd2533`，10 文件 0 工件 0 E 资产；在 `2d6c723` 复跑端到端 39/39 SCRIPT_RC=0，送 ora-1 有界复审。自查纠正：awk 锚点未匹配致假阳性 IDENTICAL、`jcs.py selftest` 实为位置参数。
</p2>
<p3>
三项公共集成修复（契约 13 处 nullable、登出 destination_revision+1、Worker 有界周期调度）由我独立复核后按项提交 `2d6c723`；端到端 39/39、pytest 230、mvn 401 全绿。
</p3>

<compartment start="479" end="510" title="Oracle 有界复审、纯注释整改重绑定与 report-only 交付（含本轮收尾）" episode_type="investigation,docs" importance="58">
<p1>
